title: Threads and the GIL
statement: In the standard CPython 3.13 build (with the GIL), which statements are true? Pick every one that applies.
choices: Several threads running pure-Python CPU-bound code do not execute Python bytecode in parallel.
counter += 1 on a shared global int is atomic, so threads can update it without a lock.
asyncio runs coroutines on a pool of threads by default so that they use every core.
multiprocessing.Pool can speed up CPU-bound pure-Python work by using several cores.
